description.value: Brewhall is a two-floor social hall and pub from the Tap & Barrel group, situated in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood within easy reach of the city's cycling network. The main level offers a spacious bar, outdoor patio, and arcade games, while the upstairs DRINKLAB serves as a private event and trivia venue. The kitchen focuses on scratch-made, locally sourced food paired with 22 taps of craft beer and cider, and the walls display a museum-grade collection of BC and Canadian artwork.
